passage.label: tried before them people Pharaoh noble messenger came; render servants Allah trustworthy messenger; be not haughty Allah clear authority; sought refuge Lord lest stone me; if not believe leave me alone; called Lord criminal people; set out My servants night pursued; leave sea stillness army drowned; left behind gardens springs crops noble sites comfort amused; thus inherited another people; heaven earth wept not nor reprieved; saved Children Israel humiliating torment; Pharaoh haughty transgressors; chose them knowledge over worlds; gave signs clear trial

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ
أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ

mainSubject.label: The prior trial of Pharaoh's people through a noble messenger demanding the release of Allah's servants as a trustworthy envoy bearing clear authority; his refuge-seeking against stoning and his conditional withdrawal if unbelieved; his appeal to his Lord naming them criminals followed by the night departure with pursuit and the sea left in stillness for the drowning army; enumeration of abandoned gardens, springs, crops, noble sites and amusement-comfort inherited by another people while heaven and earth neither wept nor granted reprieve; the Children of Israel saved from humiliating torment under a haughty transgressor, chosen by knowledge above the worlds and given signs containing clear trial

notes: Wave 7 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the greatest-assault retribution (16) before the Pharaoh trial narrative opens (17); P2 ends with Israel's election and signs (33); P3 covers the denial-of-resurrection block through the mercy exception (34-42); P4 runs from Zaqqum through the righteous reward and the closing mutual-watch command (43-59).
